paragraphs: Tablet Command makes mobile incident command and response software for fire and EMS agencies. Commanders run an incident on a digital command board, dragging and dropping unit assignments.

The software is built on the iPad platform. A commander can tap and drag responding apparatus onto a scene, track progress against critical checklists, and time-stamp every maneuver and benchmark. Maps carry pre-plans and custom layers for hydrants, hospitals, landing zones, flood hazards and fire trails. The app is native and designed to run entirely independent of internet connectivity. It connects to CAD systems and integrates Esri GIS map layers, pre-plans, FireMapper and AVL.

The site reports over 250,000 incidents managed, covering everyday calls and multi-agency coordination. The product is also positioned as a complete replacement for mobile data terminals in the fire service. San Bernardino County Fire is named as using it in every front line response unit. A case study describes Stockton Fire Department turning to it as an MDT replacement and fire ground accountability tool.
